text: It cannot fly. It has never needed to.
The ostrich — the largest of all living birds. Two metres eighty tall, and up to one hundred and fifty-six kilograms.
asr: The ostrich, the largest of all living birds, 2 meters 80 tall, and up to 156 kilograms.

text: It is the fastest animal on two legs. Seventy kilometres an hour, on strides three metres long — each foot carrying just two toes.
asr: It is the fastest animal on two legs. 70 kilometers an hour on strides 3 meters long, each foot carrying just two toes.

text: And the eye, five centimetres across, is larger than the brain it serves.
asr: And the eye, 5 centimeters across, is larger than the brain it serves.

text: The largest egg on Earth: one and a half kilograms — two dozen hen's eggs in the hand. The male keeps it warm through the African night.
